about: The 15 situations George must win in Brazil. Each is a role-play in the Treino app. Pass = every goal done in Portuguese and a debrief score of 7+. Level 2 = pass again with a twist.

situations.title: Conhecendo alguém novo
situations.brief: You are Rafa, a friendly Corinthians fan from São Paulo, meeting George for the first time at a party. You are curious about him and tease him gently about supporting Tottenham.

open.pt: E aí, beleza? Eu sou o Rafa. Cê é amigo de quem aqui?
open.en: Hey, all good? I'm Rafa. Whose friend are you here?

goals: Introduce himself and say where he's from and where he lives
Say what he does for work
Explain why he's learning Portuguese
Ask Rafa two questions about himself

must.en: Nice to meet you! I'm George.
I work in FX.

must.pt: Tô aprendendo português porque a minha namorada é brasileira.
must.en: I'm learning Portuguese because my girlfriend is Brazilian.

must.pt: E você? Cê é de onde?
must.en: And you? Where are you from?

twists: The music is loud: mishear him once and ask him to repeat something.
Introduce him to a second person (play both) who asks the same things faster.

situations.title: Na cafeteria e na padaria
situations.brief: You are a quick, cheerful barista at a busy café. You offer things with cheese and egg (pão de queijo, misto quente) because they are popular, ask 'pra viagem ou pra comer aqui?', and say the price in reais.

open.pt: Bom dia! O que vai ser hoje?

goals: Order a drink and something to eat
Turn down something with cheese or egg politely and choose another thing
Say whether it's to take away or eat in
Ask the price and pay

must.pt: Me vê um café com leite, por favor.
must.en: Can I get a white coffee, please.

must.pt: Sem queijo, por favor. Eu não como queijo.
must.en: No cheese, please. I don't eat cheese.
It's to take away.
How much is it?
Is card OK?

twists: Speak fast and run two questions together once.
The card machine isn't working: ask if he has cash or Pix.

situations.title: No restaurante
situations.brief: You are a waiter. Recommend the dish of the day (moqueca de peixe) first, then other dishes. Ask about drinks, how he wants the meat, and dessert.

open.pt: Boa noite! Mesa pra quantas pessoas?
open.en: Good evening! Table for how many?

goals: Ask for a table and the menu
Explain he doesn't eat fish, eggs or cheese and ask for a recommendation
Order a main and a drink
Ask for the bill

must.pt: Uma mesa pra dois, por favor.
must.en: A table for two, please.

must.pt: Eu não como peixe, nem ovo, nem queijo.
must.en: I don't eat fish, eggs or cheese.
What do you recommend?
The bill, please.

twists: The dish he orders has run out: offer two alternatives, one with cheese.
Bring the wrong drink and see if he sorts it out politely.

situations.title: Como foi o seu dia?
situations.brief: You are Ana, George's Tandem partner from São Paulo. You want to hear about his day and his weekend in detail, and you react a lot (Nossa! Sério? Que legal!).

open.pt: Oi, George! E aí, como foi o seu dia?
open.en: Hi, George! So, how was your day?

goals: Describe today in the past tense (work, train, gym)
Tell what he did last weekend
Tell one small story with aí / então / de repente
Ask Ana about her day

must.en: Today was really hectic.
I worked all day.

must.pt: No fim de semana eu fui pra academia.
must.en: At the weekend I went to the gym.

must.pt: E o seu dia, como foi?
must.en: And your day, how was it?

twists: Ask 'por quê?' after two of his answers so he has to give reasons.
Tell him a short story of your own and check he followed by asking about it.

situations.title: Na academia
situations.brief: You are a regular at a gym in São Paulo using the bench George wants. You are friendly, notice he's foreign, and ask about his training. You know a good boxing gym nearby.

open.pt: Opa! Cê quer usar esse banco?
open.en: Hey! Do you want to use this bench?

goals: Ask to share the equipment or how many sets are left
Say what he's training today and how often he trains
Say he does boxing and ask where he can train
Thank him and say goodbye

must.en: Can I work in with you?
How many sets have you got left?

must.pt: Treino todo dia. Hoje é peito e costas.
must.en: I train every day. Today is chest and back.

must.pt: Cê conhece uma academia de boxe por aqui?
must.en: Do you know a boxing gym round here?

twists: Invite him to a boxing class tomorrow at a specific time: he must agree a time and place.
Use gym slang (pegar pesado, tá puxado) and see if he asks what it means.

situations.title: A nossa história
situations.brief: You are Gabi's mum, warm and chatty. You already know George but have never heard him speak Portuguese, so you are delighted. George calls you 'a senhora'. You ask how he and Gabi met, about his family, and what he was like as a child.

open.pt: George, senta aqui! Me conta: como foi que cê conheceu a Gabi?
open.en: George, sit here! Tell me: how did you meet Gabi?

goals: Tell how he and Gabi met (online, then in person in London)
Talk about his family: one brother, two sisters
Say one thing about his childhood using era / morava / jogava
Use 'a senhora' at least once

must.en: We met online.

must.pt: E depois a gente se viu pessoalmente em Londres.
must.en: And then we saw each other in person in London.

must.pt: Tenho um irmão e duas irmãs.
must.en: I have one brother and two sisters.

must.pt: Quando eu era pequeno, eu jogava futebol todo dia.
must.en: When I was little, I played football every day.
And you? (respectful)

twists: Ask what he thought of Gabi the first time he saw her.
Ask, half joking, when they are getting married.

situations.title: No aeroporto
situations.brief: You are an immigration officer at Guarulhos, then a help-desk attendant. Polite but brisk. Ask the purpose of the trip, how long he's staying and where. Then help him find baggage claim, an ATM or exchange, and the Uber pick-up.

open.pt: Boa noite. Passaporte, por favor. Qual é o motivo da viagem?
open.en: Good evening. Passport, please. What's the purpose of your trip?

goals: Say why he's come and how long he's staying
Say where he's staying (his girlfriend's mum's house in São Paulo)
Ask where baggage claim or the exit is
Ask where he can get an Uber or change money

must.en: I've come to visit my girlfriend.
I'm going to stay three weeks.

must.pt: Vou ficar na casa da mãe dela.
must.en: I'm staying at her mum's house.
Where's the exit?
Where do I get the Uber?

twists: His bag hasn't arrived: send him to the baggage desk and ask him to describe it.
Ask for the address where he's staying; he must say he'll check his phone.

situations.title: No avião
situations.brief: You are a chatty Brazilian passenger going home to São Paulo for Christmas. You are impressed a 'gringo' speaks Portuguese and ask lots of questions. You recommend places in São Paulo and Rio.

open.pt: Com licença, esse lugar é seu? Cê é brasileiro?
open.en: Excuse me, is this your seat? Are you Brazilian?

goals: Say where he's from and why he's going to Brazil
Say what he's going to do there (São Paulo, then New Year in Rio)
Say how long he's been learning Portuguese
Ask for a recommendation

must.en: No, I'm English.

must.pt: Vou passar o Natal em São Paulo.
must.en: I'm spending Christmas in São Paulo.

must.pt: Depois vou pro Rio pro Réveillon.
must.en: Then I'm going to Rio for New Year.
I've been learning for four months.
What do you recommend?

twists: Ask what he'll miss about England and what he's most looking forward to.
Talk for three sentences in a row about your family, then ask a question about what you said.

situations.title: O Uber e a Marginal
situations.place: An Uber stuck on the Marginal Tietê
situations.brief: You are an Uber driver in São Paulo, talkative, a Corinthians fan. Confirm the destination, complain about the traffic, ask where he's from, and talk football. Use 'mó trânsito', 'meu'.

open.pt: Boa noite! George, né? Vai pra onde mesmo?
open.en: Evening! George, right? Where are you headed again?

goals: Confirm his name and where he's going
React to the traffic and ask how long it will take
Answer where he's from and what team he supports
Ask the driver to stop at the right place and thank him

must.en: That's right, it's me.
How long does it take?
I support Tottenham.
You can stop here, please.
Cheers, good night!

twists: Ask whether he prefers one route or another (pela Marginal ou por dentro).
Miss the turning and ask him which house it is.

situations.title: Chegando em casa
situations.place: The front door of Gabi's mum's flat
situations.brief: You are Gabi's mum. George has just arrived from the airport and, to your surprise, speaks Portuguese: react with real delight. Ask about the flight, whether he's hungry or tired, offer food (including something with cheese or egg), show him where to put his things.

open.pt: George! Que bom te ver! Entra, entra! Como foi a viagem?
open.en: George! So good to see you! Come in, come in! How was the journey?

goals: Greet her warmly using 'a senhora' and say it's good to see her
Describe the journey (long, tired, but happy to be here)
Accept or refuse food politely, explaining what he doesn't eat
Give a compliment about the house or the food

must.en: So good to see you!

must.pt: A viagem foi longa, mas tô muito animado de estar aqui.
must.en: The journey was long, but I'm really excited to be here.
Excuse me (coming in).

must.pt: Obrigado, mas eu não como ovo.
must.en: Thank you, but I don't eat eggs.
It's delicious!

twists: Ask who taught him Portuguese and why he kept it secret.
Speak quickly and warmly for several sentences, then ask if he understood everything.

situations.title: Pedindo informação
situations.brief: You are a helpful stranger on Avenida Paulista, then a metro ticket clerk. Give directions with direita, esquerda, reto, perto, longe, quarteirões. Explain which metro line and which stop.

open.en: Hi! Are you lost? Can I help?

goals: Ask where a place is and whether it's near or far
Repeat the directions back to check
Ask which metro line or bus to take and where to get off
Buy a ticket or ask how to pay

must.pt: Com licença, onde fica o metrô?
must.en: Excuse me, where's the metro?
Is it near or far?

must.pt: Então eu viro à direita e sigo reto?
must.en: So I turn right and go straight on?
Which line do I take?
Which station do I get off at?

twists: Give the directions fast the first time; slow down only if he asks.
Tell him the line is closed today and suggest a bus instead.

situations.title: Os amigos da Gabi
situations.brief: You are Bia, Gabi's friend, at a bar with a group. You are funny and use São Paulo slang (meu, mano, mó, rolê, firmeza, da hora). You tease him about Tottenham and ask what he thinks of São Paulo, and you invite him to something this week.

open.pt: Então cê que é o famoso George! Prazer, eu sou a Bia. Tá gostando de São Paulo?
open.en: So you're the famous George! Nice to meet you, I'm Bia. Are you liking São Paulo?

goals: Introduce himself and say what he thinks of São Paulo so far
Give an opinion with 'acho que' and a reason
Handle teasing about Tottenham or football with humour
Make a plan: agree a day and swap numbers

must.en: I'm really liking it!

must.pt: Acho que São Paulo é mó legal.
must.en: I think São Paulo is really cool.

must.pt: O Spurs perde muito, mas eu sou fiel.
must.en: Spurs lose a lot, but I'm loyal.

must.pt: Bora marcar! Me passa seu número.
must.en: Let's set it up! Give me your number.

twists: Bring a second friend into the chat who talks over you once (play both).
Ask what the biggest difference is between London and São Paulo.

situations.title: Compras e farmácia
situations.place: A shop in a busy shopping centre
situations.brief: You are a shop assistant in a crowded shopping centre before Christmas. Ask what he's looking for, his size, the colour, whether it's a gift, and whether he'll pay by card, cash or Pix. Offer to gift-wrap.

open.pt: Oi, tudo bem? Posso ajudar? Tá procurando alguma coisa?
open.en: Hi, how are you? Can I help? Are you looking for something?

goals: Say what he's looking for and who it's for
Ask for a size or colour and to try it on
Ask the price and react (expensive / cheaper one?)
Pay and ask for it to be gift-wrapped

must.pt: Tô procurando um presente pra minha sogra.
must.en: I'm looking for a present for my mother-in-law.
Do you have it in another size?
Can I try it on?
Is there a cheaper one?
Can you gift-wrap it?

twists: Switch scene to a pharmacy: he has a headache and needs something simple.
His card is declined: he must sort out another way to pay.

situations.title: Ceia de Natal
situations.brief: You are Gabi's mum hosting Christmas dinner. Offer food repeatedly (some with cheese, egg or fish), ask about Christmas in England, his plans for next year, and at some point, affectionately, when he and Gabi will marry. Propose a toast.

open.pt: George, vem! Senta aqui do meu lado. Cê já experimentou a farofa?
open.en: George, come! Sit here next to me. Have you tried the farofa yet?

goals: Compliment the food and the evening
Refuse a dish politely and accept another
Describe Christmas in England and compare it with Brazil
Answer a personal question with humour and politeness
Join or make a toast

must.en: Everything is delicious!

must.pt: Obrigado, mas eu não como peixe. Vou querer mais arroz!
must.en: Thank you, but I don't eat fish. I'll have more rice!

must.pt: Na Inglaterra faz muito frio no Natal.
must.en: In England it's very cold at Christmas.
One day, who knows!
Cheers! Thank you for having me.

twists: Explain the rules of amigo secreto quickly and ask him to describe the person he drew.
Two relatives talk at once (play both); one asks about his job, the other about football.

situations.title: Réveillon e o brinde
situations.en: New Year, a problem and the toast
situations.brief: You are Gabi on New Year's Eve in Copacabana, speaking to George at full natural speed with slang. Talk about the traditions (roupa branca, pular sete ondas), ask his wishes for the new year, then a problem: he can't find his phone and must ask a stranger (you play them) for help. Finally ask him to give a short toast.

open.pt: Amor, olha quanta gente! Cê já viu um Réveillon assim?
open.en: Love, look how many people! Have you ever seen a New Year like this?

goals: React and talk about the traditions
Say his wishes and plans for next year using 'vou' and 'quero'
Sort out a problem by asking a stranger for help
Give a toast of at least three sentences and say thank you

must.en: I've never seen anything like it!

must.pt: Ano que vem quero viajar pela América do Sul.
must.en: Next year I want to travel around South America.

must.pt: Com licença, preciso de ajuda. Perdi o meu celular.
must.en: Excuse me, I need help. I've lost my phone.
I'd like to make a toast.

must.pt: Feliz Ano Novo! Que seja um ano incrível.
must.en: Happy New Year! May it be an incredible year.

twists: There's a misunderstanding: he must apologise and say what he meant (eu quis dizer…).
Ask him to say goodbye to the whole family at the airport and promise to come back.
